_about: Every public-domain Andrew Lang (1844-1912) text the Word Hoard holds: the twelve Coloured Fairy Books and the other Lang-edited story books, his own fairy tales and fiction, his Homer/Theocritus/Aucassin translations (Homer kept on this shelf with its own slugs; a Homer section may cross-reference it later), poetry, essays, myth and folklore scholarship, and histories. Gutenberg texts are clean; Internet Archive items are raw OCR (<id>_djvu.txt), unconverted. CCEL holds no Lang. Co-authors, co-translators and Mrs. Lang (Leonora Blanche Lang, who wrote much of the later story books) are credited in the title string. Lang died 1912: everything here was published before 1930 and is US public domain.
